description: Substrate-pocket electrostatics around the catalytic cysteine: can Oca6 still bind an inositol pyrophosphate non-catalytically?
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
aa3to1=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',
            LEU='L',LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V')
def get(u): return requests.get(u, headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=120).text
def atoms(txt, chain=None):
    rows=[]
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[16] in (" ","A") and (chain is None or l[21]==chain):
            rows.append((l[12:16].strip(), l[17:20].strip(), int(l[22:26]),
                         float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["name","res","resi","x","y","z"])

# Siw14 pocket is built to bind 5-InsP7 (net charge about -10) -> strongly basic.
# Does Oca6 retain a comparably basic pocket (which would permit non-catalytic binding)?
TG=[("ScOca6 (AF)","https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q12454-F1-model_v6.pdb",None,114),
    ("ScSiw14 (AF)","https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P53965-F1-model_v6.pdb",None,214),
    ("ScSiw14 (xtal 6BYF)","https://files.rcsb.org/download/6BYF.pdb","A",214),
    ("ScOca1 (AF)","https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P50946-F1-model_v6.pdb",None,168),
    ("ScOca2 (AF)","https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P53949-F1-model_v6.pdb",None,102),
    ("AtDSP1 (AF)","https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9ZVN4-F1-model_v6.pdb",None,150)]
out=[]
for nm,url,ch,cys in TG:
    A=atoms(get(url),ch)
    sg=A[(A.resi==cys)&(A.name=="SG")]
    if len(sg)==0: sg=A[(A.resi==cys)&(A.name=="CB")]
    c=sg[["x","y","z"]].values[0]
    sc=A[A.name=="CB"].copy()  # side-chain proxy, one per residue (Gly excluded)
    sc["d"]=np.sqrt(((sc[["x","y","z"]].values-c)**2).sum(1))
    for cut in (10,12,15):
        pass
    near=sc[sc.d<=12]
    nbas=int(near.res.isin(["ARG","LYS"]).sum()); nhis=int((near.res=="HIS").sum())
    nacid=int(near.res.isin(["ASP","GLU"]).sum())
    out.append(dict(protein=nm, catCys=cys, residues_within_12A=len(near),
                    Arg_Lys=nbas, His=nhis, Asp_Glu=nacid, net_charge=nbas-nacid,
                    charge_per_100res=round(100*(nbas-nacid)/max(1,len(near)),1)))
P=pd.DataFrame(out); pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print("Charged side chains within 12 A of the catalytic cysteine (substrate pocket):")
print(P.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,4.2))
x=np.arange(len(P)); w=0.35
ax.bar(x-w/2,P.Arg_Lys,w,label="Arg + Lys",color="#4C78A8")
ax.bar(x+w/2,P.Asp_Glu,w,label="Asp + Glu",color="#E45756")
for i,v in enumerate(P.net_charge): ax.text(i,max(P.Arg_Lys[i],P.Asp_Glu[i])+0.4,f"net {v:+d}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(P.protein,rotation=18,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("charged side chains within 12 A of catalytic Cys")
ax.set_title("Substrate pocket electrostatics: Oca6 pocket is net negative,\nactive family members are net positive")
ax.legend(); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
